up: Retrieve the exact activity values and chemical structures for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649943. Return the assay CHEMBL ID, compound CHEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard activity type, standard relation, exact standard value, and standard units. Filter for exact values only where the standard relation equals '='. Join assays to activities via assay_id, activities to molecule_dictionary via molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures via molregno. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value AS exact_standard_value, a.standard_units FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649943' AND a.standard_relation = '='
